notes: names[] is a deduped list of forms (singular/plural × long/short/narrow), intended for case-insensitive matching during fact extraction.
long/short/narrow each map plural categories (one, other, ...) to forms — use these if you need to know which form is singular vs plural.
Currency 'symbol' is omitted when CLDR uses the code itself.
currencies filtered to those legal-tender or non-tender (e.g. precious metals) somewhere in the world on 2026-05-01; XTS and XXX placeholders excluded.
